title: A booking mistake
text: Mai has just booked a hotel room for Saturday, but she chose the wrong date. She has changed a booking online twice before, so she is not worried. She has already called the hotel, and they have sent her a new email. She has not paid yet, so the change is free. She has been a member since 2022, and she has stayed in this hotel several times. The last time was in June. So far the staff have been very helpful.

questions.q: Has she paid for the room?
questions.explain: She has not paid yet, so the change is free.

questions.q: How long has she been a member?
